mentions.h: Southern Road-Relay — BELS BACK IN THE MEDALS — BELGRAVE & SOUTHERN COUNTIES AAA ROAD RELAY---8th April 1972
mentions.note: stage 7, 25:08, 10th fastest; first outing in the race; Irish
new member from the same Irish club as Tony Brien; first-year student at St. Mary's College, Twickenham; 2nd
returned to Ireland after finishing studies at St. Mary's College
won Club 7 mile cross country championship, December 2nd 1972
